paragraphs.zh: NMST (20g, 0.088mol), sodium hypochlorite (150ml, 0.222mol) and ruthenium oxide (0.5g, 0.004mol) were charged into a 500ml round bottomed flask. This mixture was heated to reflux temperature under stirring for 6-8 hours, cooled to 25-30°C and filtered. The filtrate obtained was further cooled to 5-10°C and acidified to pH < 3 using concentrated hydrochloric acid (54mL, 0.51mol) to form precipitated product (NMSBA). The product obtained was filtered and dried at 50°C under reduced pressure to obtain NMSBA as light yellow solid.

drawings.notes: The only drawing on the page, sitting between the Example 4 title line and the paragraph marked with the four-digit number ending 50. Two labels are printed under the drawing and nothing else: 'Formula III' centred under the 1st structure and 'Formula II' centred under the 3rd. The 2nd structure, 1,3-cyclohexanedione, carries NO printed label at all; its identity is read off the drawing only. The reagents are joined by a printed '+' between the 1st and 2nd structures. Nothing whatsoever is written above or below the arrow, so both reagent lists are empty; that is an absence on the page, not something I failed to read. Per brief section 9, the arrow is recorded as solid: every bond in this drawing, ring bonds included, has broken into evenly spaced dots in the same way, so the arrow's dotted look is the same scan degradation and not a drawn dashed bond. The arrowhead is a single solid filled head pointing right.
